observations: Three photos show a black console wrapped in clear plastic, placed on a blue plastic chair.
A black DualShock 4 controller is resting on top of the console.
A black USB flash drive labeled 'CHUKEZ' is also on top of the console.
The console has a rectangular shape with a visible seam down the middle, consistent with a PlayStation 4 model.
No branding or model numbers are visible on the console in any photo.
The console appears to be in a used condition, with some scuff marks visible through the plastic wrap.
The seller's text claims it is a 'clean UK used PS4 hacked with 10 free latest games installed', including FIFA 25, MK11, Call of Duty, GTA 5, God of War, etc.

identity.kind: PlayStation 4 console with controller and USB drive

claims.claim: Clean UK used PS4 hacked with 10 free latest games installed
claims.evidence: No visible proof of hacking or installed games. The console is wrapped and no screen is shown. The claim of 'free latest games' cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Includes FIFA 25, MK11, Call of Duty, GTA 5, God of War
claims.evidence: No screen or game list shown. Cannot verify if these games are installed or even exist on the device.
The console appears used with scuffs visible through plastic wrap. No proof of origin (UK) or cleaning process.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have hardware issues
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game.

risks.risk: The 'hacked' claim may be false or the console may be bricked
risks.proof: A video showing the console accessing pirated games or custom firmware interface.

risks.risk: The games listed may not be installed or may be outdated/invalid
risks.proof: A screen recording showing the game library with the listed titles and gameplay of at least one game.

risks.risk: The console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number and a verification from Sony or a trusted reseller.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high risk, possibly unusable

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Screen recording showing the game library with the listed games and gameplay of at least one game.
Photo of the console's serial number.
Video showing the custom firmware or hacking interface if applicable.
response.reason: The console's identity is clear as a PlayStation 4 type, but critical claims about hacking, game installation, and functionality cannot be verified from the photos alone. Without proof of working condition and installed games, the item cannot be priced accurately and carries significant risk.
